defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Press Ice Block to fully immune a lethal hit or to drop a dangerous debuff; it stuns you so use it only when you can afford to stop casting.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Activate Alter Time before a large incoming hit to rewind back to your starting health and position when it expires, or double-tap it as a short mobility blink.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: Use Greater Invisibility to wipe threat, drop targeted mechanics, and gain a 60% damage reduction for several seconds after the fade.

defensives.name: Mirror Image
defensives.usage_rule: Summon Mirror Image to reduce damage taken while the copies are active; talent-gated, so having zero casts is normal if you did not take it.

defensives.name: Prismatic Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Keep Prismatic Barrier up as a must-cast absorb shield; its cast time is only 0.5s now, so refresh it proactively before predictable magic damage.
